accepted: Pitch-only reference transfer, with every production sound duration and pause unchanged.
review: Native listener: that is better and worthy to be pushed.

source: Pitch measured from Björn in kokoro-sv-alice-bjorn-2c7968d-v3; aligned using predicted token timings. This alignment is approximate and must not be used as ground-truth acoustic phone boundaries.

runtime_requirement: Replaying this contour needs no neural model. Generating a reference contour for arbitrary new text does; it is a listening benchmark, not a general prosody model.
